scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm run test:music-engines && pnpm run test:validation && pnpm run test:analysis-providers && pnpm run test:source-ingestion && pnpm run test:revisions && pnpm run test:export-lineage && pnpm run test:copilot
scripts.test:export: sh -c 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/music-studio-api-tests.XXXXXX) && trap "rm -rf \"$tmpdir\"" EXIT && esbuild src/lib/exportAudioRoles.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/export-audio-roles.test.mjs" && esbuild src/lib/exportCleanupRate.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/export-cleanup-rate.test.mjs" && node --test "$tmpdir/export-audio-roles.test.mjs" "$tmpdir/export-cleanup-rate.test.mjs" tests/export-pipeline.test.mjs tests/export-jobs-pedalboard.test.mjs tests/export-object-recovery.test.mjs'
scripts.test:music-engines: sh -c 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/music-studio-api-tests.XXXXXX) && trap "rm -rf \"$tmpdir\"" EXIT && esbuild tests/music-engines.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/music-engines.test.mjs" && esbuild src/lib/candidateRanking.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/candidate-ranking.test.mjs" && esbuild src/lib/candidateQuality.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/candidate-quality.test.mjs" && esbuild src/lib/candidateRepair.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="$tmpdir/candidate-repair.test.mjs" && node --test "$tmpdir/music-engines.test.mjs" "$tmpdir/candidate-ranking.test.mjs" "$tmpdir/candidate-quality.test.mjs" "$tmpdir/candidate-repair.test.mjs"'
